steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, places: 1, shop: 1, rods: 1, look: 1, baits: 1, aqua_btn: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1 }; S.coins = 20000; S.pearls = 300; FB.hud.update(); window.__wear = async (who, hat, jk) => { FB.ui.closeAll(); S.who = who; [hat, jk].forEach(id => { if (!S.owned.includes(id)) S.owned.push(id); FB.shop.equip(id); }); FB.hud.update(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); };

steps.name: шапки
steps.js: FB.shopUI.open('look'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); document.querySelectorAll('.sheet .tabs')[1].querySelectorAll('.tab')[1].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));

steps.name: куртки
steps.js: document.querySelector('.shade:last-child .sheet-body').scrollTop = 0; document.querySelectorAll('.sheet .tabs')[1].querySelectorAll('.tab')[2].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));
